what_it_is: AeroVironment (AV) is a Virginia-headquartered US defence-technology company specialising in small unmanned aircraft systems, loitering munitions (the Switchblade family) and counter-UAS technologies. It is the Pentagon's dominant supplier of man-portable loitering munitions and has expanded into high-altitude pseudo-satellites and uncrewed maritime systems through recent acquisitions.
india_angle: The atlas lists AeroVironment in the India UAS company atlas, but no India contract or authorised-sales case for Switchblade or JUMP 20 systems has been publicly confirmed. US policy shifts on armed-drone exports (MTCR Category I relaxation) opened the door for Indian acquisition discussions, which remain unverified at dossier time.
intelligence_assessment: AV's product record is exceptionally well documented in US sources, which raises the atlas bar for its India file: any Indian order would be a major policy signal for armed UAS/loitering-munition proliferation to South Asia. Treat all India linkage as speculative until an FMS case, Indian budget line or vendor announcement appears.

faq.a: No Indian Switchblade procurement is publicly confirmed; the atlas listing reflects programme relevance, not a verified order.
